## What changed

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible change.

## Why

Explain the problem and the chosen approach.

## Tracking

Link the issue this pull request resolves, for example `Closes #123`. If there
is no accepted issue, explain why the change is small enough not to require one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The linked issue's acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors or upgrades

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] Python lint passes
- [ ] Web typecheck/build passes when applicable
- [ ] Web interaction tests pass when applicable
- [ ] Packaged-node behavior was checked when applicable

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, personal content, or real private infrastructure details are included
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where behavior changed
